These 32GB M5 MacBook Pro models just hit new all-time lows today at up to $350 off the orig. list prices

Update 5/11: Amazon is now offering both the Silver and Space Black 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 32GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,849 shipped – this is a new all-time low at $250 off.

Amazon’s MacBook Pro deals are still flying and we just spotted a new all-time low landing on an upgraded M5 model. While you’ll still find plenty of M5 Pro offers below, the 32GB/1TB M5 has just dropped to a new all-time low at $250 off the list price. That said, B&H is actually offering the 32GB/512GB model at a whopping $350 off the original list today.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 32GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,849 shipped. This configuration carries a $2,099 list price and is now seeing a straight up $250 price drop at Amazon. We saw this new-to-Amazon setup hit a new all-time low at $150 off nearer the top of the month, but it began trickling down by a few bucks almost everyday since, until earlier this morning when it fell to a new all-time low.

That’s a solid discount, but, as mentioned above, B&H is going hard on the 32GB model with 512GB of storage today as well – it has now dropped from the regular $1,999 all the way down to $1,649 shipped. We are looking at easily one of the best deals we have tracked on any M5 machine to date here at $350 off the originally list price.

This deal is a particularly notable one, not just because of the seriously $350 price drop here, but also because this is a configuration you can’t even buy at Apple anymore (or Amazon for that matter). Apple ditched the 512GB storage tiers back in March with the launch of the new M5 Pro lineup, leaving these unicorn 512GB models as some of the best value in current-gen M5-powered machines (providing you can make the 512GB of storage wrk for you). This one, admittedly, carries an effective list price at $1,899 now because, with the storage tier bump, its price is more realistically more like $1,899, but you’re either way looking at the best deal we have tracked.

Rare discount hits latest Philips Hue Bridge Pro at $79 today

Deals on the latest Philips Hue Bridge Pro have been rare at best – it was hard to even get at full price for a while there. While it is still out of stock on the official Hue site, it has been readily available on Amazon at full price some time now, and we are catching a rare discount today at just over $79 via Crutchfield.

Crutchfield launched a wide-ranging May sale event this morning and, in it, we are seeing Philips Hue Bridge Pro down at $79.19 shipped. Regularly $99, this is the lowest price we can find and quite a rare chance to upgrade your setup with the latest Pro model at a discount.

Still fetching $99 at Amazon, Hue Bridge Pro is yet to see any discounts there – today’s deal is the lowest price we have tracked in terms of a straight cash discount on the list price.

This model launched in September 2025 as the latest bridge solution from the brand, complete with upgrades across the board over the old and now aging model:

  • Supports 150+ lights, 50+ accessories
  • Use lights as motion sensors with MotionAware
  • Unlocks Hue Sync surround lighting and security integration
  • Compatible with Apple Home, Alexa, Google Assistant, Samsung SmartThings
  • Advanced encryption with Zigbee Trust Center

It comes with everything you need to get it hooked into your network including the Hue Bridge Pro itself, a 5-foot Ethernet cable (RJ-45 plugs on both ends), the AC adapter with a 5-foot DC output cord and USB-C plug (DC output: 5V 1A), and the usual 2-prong AC plug adapter.

Best 2026 iPad deal yet? Brand new mid-range 256GB iPad Air hits all-time low at nearly $110 off (All colors)

We catch giant deals from time-to-time on current-gen MacBook models north of $200 off the list, and the latest iPad Pro with hundreds in savings, but Apple’s more affordable gear/configurations naturally land with far more modest discounts. The iPad Air, and more specifically the latest model, is a perfect example of this, and exactly why this mid-range 256GB model at nearly $110 off is such a notable discount.

This week, Amazon is offering some new all-time low pricing on the new M4 iPad Air lineup. While we were tracking as much as $100 off the most expensive 1TB model, which does not come as a giant surprise, the 256GB with an even steeper discount is to some degree.

Amazon is currently offering deals on a few of the more affordable storage capacities in the M4 iPad Air lineup, including the least expensive of them all at $80 off, but perhaps none more notable than the 13-inch 256GB in all four colors at nearly $110 off:

Amazon now has Apple’s new 13-inch M4 iPad Air with the 256GB storage capacity down at $789.99 shipped in all four colors.

As you can see by the updated deal prices across the lineup below, and considering it took nearly an entire year to see the now previous-generation at $200+ off, this particular offer is perhaps the best we have tracked on the new M4 model.

I would argue the 1TB configurations are overkill for just about anyone willing to spend that much on an iPad – you can get an M5 iPad Pro for that sort of money – and the 128GB configuration should be banished for good at this point. Okay, that last ting is a bit harsh – I, personally, don’t need anymore than that in terms of storage on an iPad, I just think we have moved past the 128GB tier at this point on just about all tech.

This leaves the 256GB in the sweet spot. Most folks don’t really need all that much storage on an iPad, just enough for some breathing room without having to go through the, sometimes, dreaded process of manually freeing up space in year or so, and the 256GB is a nice middle ground between price and capacity that fits the needs of what I would argue is the bulk of potential iPad customers.

If you think I’m crazy, I get it – some folks beat the camera roll up good and good on them, I’m just not one of them (on an iPad) and I don’t want to spend any more than I have to on this already pricey tech. If you do or, in the other direction, don’t even need that much, the best deals on the M4 iPad Air lineup await below:
